profile.name: Rohith Reddy
profile.headline: Investments at RevX | Private Credit | Venture Debt
profile.about:
I am a finance professional with ~4 years of experience in the private credit space. My work involves end-to-end deal execution - from sourcing transactions through my network, evaluating them, negotiating commercial terms, conducting due diligence, closing transactions, and monitoring portfolio companies.

I work closely with startups and growth-stage companies to help them access the right credit solutions without diluting equity.

Being in private credit, I interact with founders, investors, investment bankers, and other stakeholders across the ecosystem, in the process of evaluating multiple businesses every day. Over time, this has given me the opportunity to build perspectives on businesses, sectors/industries, credit, and investing.

I created this website as a platform to share those thoughts through blogs. I enjoy taking simple concepts and adding a little perspective based on my experiences and learnings along the way.

Please feel free to explore the Blogs section.

experience.title: Analyst - Investments
experience.description: Managing end-to-end deal execution for venture debt and private credit transactions at a CAT-2 AIF. Sourcing deals through network, conducting credit evaluations, leading negotiations, overseeing due diligence, and monitoring portfolio performance.
highlights: Structuring tailored debt solutions for high-growth companies to scale without equity dilution
Executing the full deal lifecycle: sourcing, credit evaluation, negotiations, due diligence, and closure
Monitoring portfolio companies and managing post-investment relationships

experience.title: Analyst - Credit and Risk
experience.description: Managed credit risk assessment and monitoring for the investment portfolio. Conducted detailed financial analysis, evaluated borrower creditworthiness, and monitored portfolio health.
highlights: Conducted comprehensive credit risk assessments for prospective borrowers
Monitored existing portfolio for risk indicators and covenant compliance
Prepared detailed credit memos and risk reports for investment committee

experience.title: Executive - Credit and Risk
experience.description: Executed credit evaluation and risk monitoring processes. Analyzed financial statements, assessed borrower creditworthiness, and supported deal execution across the credit lifecycle.
highlights: Performed detailed financial statement analysis to assess borrower creditworthiness
Supported deal execution through credit evaluation, due diligence, and documentation
Monitored portfolio performance and flagged early warning indicators for at-risk accounts

experience.title: Financial Analyst
experience.description: Collaborated with US Financial Advisors to facilitate business expansion by developing and streamlining processes. Clients included small and medium businesses, business owners, HNIs, physicians, and dentists.
highlights: Obtained complete financial profiles and created comprehensive financial plans for clients by analyzing diverse financial documents and delivering tailored recommendations
Executed advanced planning scenarios to evaluate the potential financial impact of various events on client cash flows, enabling informed decision-making
Generated holistic reports based on client financial profiles and presented them during advisory meetings
Reviewed and analyzed investment reports to closely monitor fund performance for 401k Plan sponsors
